_note: Read 17 Sep 2026. Meraas gates the brochure, floor-plan pack, payment plan and masterplan download behind a 'Register Your Interest' form asking for name, email, phone and country. That form was NOT submitted and nothing behind it was fetched; only images published openly on the page are listed. meraas.com returns HTTP 403 to a browser user-agent, so the page was read via WebFetch and every URL below was then confirmed to return HTTP 200 before being registered. Meraas also publishes 'Bluewaters Residences PART OF A BIGGER VISION.jpg' on this page, but it is byte-identical to the asset already registered under Bluewaters Residences, so the register rejects it as a duplicate media_id; it is intentionally left out here.
